title: Rooftop Lookouts
description:
## Task

A row of buildings stands along a street, and a lookout stands on each roof facing right. From the roof of building `i`, a building further right is visible if it is strictly taller than every building standing between it and building `i`. The height of building `i` itself does not block anything. For each building, count how many buildings to its right its lookout can see.

## Input

- `heights` — a list of positive integers, the building heights from left to right. It may be empty.

## Output

A list with one count per building, in the same order.

## Example

```python
rooftop_lookouts([3, 1, 4, 2, 5])  # returns [3, 2, 2, 1, 0]
rooftop_lookouts([2, 2, 2])  # returns [1, 1, 0]
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `heights` ≤ 10^5
- 1 ≤ each height ≤ 10^9
- Expect large inputs; checking every pair of buildings may be too slow.
